core: Renal epithelial cation transport and homeostasis
name: Renal epithelial cation handling with paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: All members concern sodium, potassium or magnesium movement and homeostasis across kidney-type epithelia including tight-junction paracellular routes; magnesium and paracellular/tight-junction members are what the chloride-cotransporter and P-type ATPase confusables lack.

name: Lymphocyte and dendritic cell chemotactic homing to lymphoid organs
rationale: Members describe B, T and dendritic cell chemotaxis and migration into lymphoid organs with its Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signalling, unlike confusables centred on lymphoid tissue development or chemokine-receptor binding and dendritic cell maturation.

name: Quiescence transitions during retinoic acid-induced differentiation
rationale: Members regulate G1-G0 entry and exit linked to differentiation, with retinoic acid receptor signalling and p75NTR cell-cycle withdrawal, distinguishing it from the p53/FOXO arrest and nuclear-receptor confusables.

name: Autophagosome assembly control and depolarisation-induced mitophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore and autophagosome formation and maturation together with PINK1-PRKN and receptor-mediated mitophagy, unlike confusables lacking mitophagy or focused on mitochondrial fission and fusion.

name: Antibacterial and antifungal effector defense, peptidoglycan metabolism
rationale: Members describe antimicrobial killing, cytolysis, metal sequestration and responses to Gram-positive bacteria and yeast; peptidoglycan metabolism and peptide modification are what every confusable lacks.

qualifier: circulating particles rather than assembly or efflux
name: Circulating lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL with lipase complex assembly, whereas confusables add intestinal absorption, ABC-transporter efflux, HDL assembly or lipase activation.

name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and osteoclast development, bone resorption
rationale: Members link CSF1/M-CSF and interleukin receptor signalling to macrophage proliferation and fusion and to osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption, which confusables lack on either the osteoclast or the M-CSF side.

qualifier: NAD(P), phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Adenine nucleotide, NAD(P) and phosphocreatine energy-carrier homeostasis
rationale: Members interconvert and transport nucleotide phosphates, NAD/NADP and phosphocreatine; NAD(P) salvage and creatine/mitochondrial ADP-ATP transport distinguish it from confusables focused on nucleotide biosynthesis regulation or PRPP.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are proline synthesis and catabolism plus generic alpha/L-amino acid and glutamine-family terms, distinguishing it from serine/glycine and organic-acid confusables.

core: HDL biogenesis by ABCA1 lipid efflux
name: ABCA1-mediated HDL biogenesis and lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and cholesterol response together with HDL/LDL remodeling, which the sitosterolemia and bile-transporter confusables lack.

qualifier: cerebellar layer formation and motor learning
name: Motor coordination, motor learning and cerebellar layer formation
rationale: Members concern locomotion, reflexes, proprioception and motor learning with cerebellar and striatal development; cerebellar layer formation and motor learning distinguish it from vocal/sensory behaviour confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage, lipolysis and glycerolipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation and turnover, triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis and lipolysis and fatty acid handling in adipose context, unlike confusables about plasma lipoproteins or adipocyte differentiation.

name: Endocytic recycling and anterograde delivery to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern endosome organization, receptor recycling and endosome/Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport, distinct from confusables about retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic or membrane tubulation.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK feedback inactivation
name: RAF-MAPK cascade activation by oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF/MEK/ERK activation including BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/RAS mutants and ERK dephosphorylation feedback; RAF mutants and ERK inactivation are what the RAS-GAP and SOS confusables lack.

name: Mucosal antibacterial and antifungal defense with bacterial agglutination
rationale: Members describe antimicrobial killing, cytolysis, metal sequestration and antifungal responses; mucosal innate immunity and bacterial agglutination distinguish it from the peptidoglycan, iron-assimilation and respiratory-burst confusables.

core: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C, E handling
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation together with ascorbate metabolism and vitamin E response, unlike vitamin D, ubiquinol or oxygen-transport confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt-beta-catenin signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin/TCF signalling and destruction-complex integrity; AXIN degradation and stabilization distinguish it from confusables about DVL/FZD activation or target-gene repression.

qualifier: TNFR1 and Toll-like receptor IKK recruitment
name: TNFR1- and TLR-driven IKK recruitment, canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members describe IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation downstream of TNFR1, TLRs and RIP1/TRAF6 with linear ubiquitination, unlike non-canonical NIK, TAK1-JNK or negative-regulation confusables.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion control via KATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members cover glucose, fatty-acid, incretin and neurotransmitter control of beta-cell insulin secretion and processing; KATP channels and secretion control distinguish it from insulin-signalling and GLUT4 confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube development, satellite cell maintenance and atrophy in response to inactivity, unlike the pro-myogenesis, contraction and hypertrophy confusables.

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment
rationale: Members link cohesin loading and cohesion establishment to DNA unwinding and replication; cohesin loading distinguishes it from replication-initiation confusables, and replication from cohesion-resolution and repair confusables.

name: Cranial nerve, peripheral ganglion and pons development
rationale: Members concern cranial/peripheral ganglia, nerve and axon development and hindbrain migration; pons and hindbrain maturation distinguish it from CNS axon-guidance confusables and PNS members from the brainstem confusable.

name: Centrosome, mitotic spindle and cytokinesis organization
rationale: Members cover centrosome/MTOC function, spindle assembly and positioning, cytokinesis and centriole/cilium dynamics, unlike confusables centred on chromosome condensation and cohesion or ciliary transport.

qualifier: isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members describe germinal center B and Tfh differentiation, IgA/IgG class switching and plasma cell/immunoglobulin programs; isotype switching distinguishes it from the B cell homeostasis and surface-signature confusables.

name: T lymphocyte activation and thymocyte differentiation programs
rationale: Members are T cell activation, signalling and differentiation modules including thymocyte and generic lymphocyte programs, distinct from confusables centred on proximal TCR and CD28 costimulation events.
